name: personalaiskills
description: Skills for human connection: write one-of-a-kind thank-you notes to a person, team, organization or family (ThankYou) and warm, no-guilt check-ins with people you've drifted from (Reconnect), and seasonal gratitude lists with a pay-it-forward for each (Grateful), grounded in real shared moments, fitted to the relationship, culture and language, with a photo from a good time together or a pencil sketch of the moment, and delivered by email, WhatsApp, text, Slack and more, sent only when you say yes.
